observations.trace: Follicles.field constructs zero whorls for Forward/Backward/Down, one for Whorl/Radial and two for DoubleWhorl/Cowlick. GrowthField publicly stores and deserializes growth and a separate Vec<Whorl>; direction uses the first one or two when required and falls back to down for a missing required shape. Hairdo.comb and Orient.apply consume directions. Packed GPU source derives the field from Follicles and mirrors current 0/1/2 shape branches.
observations.remaining: Original Adler364 and delegate750 already distinguished the ordinary construction and the public aggregate policy. Whether directly serialized or hand-built inconsistent GrowthField states are supported is open; no malformed state or shader ran.

observations.trace: tangent(v,n) computes v - n*dot(v,n), which is a projection for a unit normal. GrowthField.direction accepts Vec3 n without a typed unit guarantee. For the symbolic public input Growth::Down, p=center and n=(0,2,0), the inner vector after tangent is (0.35,3,0), and the final pre-normalization vector is (0.35,-9,0), whose dot with n is -18. Head.gradient normalizes the central difference; Orient normalizes its stored normal with a fallback.
observations.remaining: This is static algebra for a non-unit input, not a proven ordinary caller or actual non-tangent runtime result. Exact finite/degenerate Head and guide input policy remains open. Earlier delegate750 had requested the actual safe_normalize body and consumer trace.

observations.contract: Existing metre and ratio owner fit
observations.trace: Hairline front, sides, nape, recession, peak and softness; Follicles memory and radius; and Whorl reach are documented as metres, while patchiness and balding are dimensionless 0-to-1 quantities. Existing fabelgeist_math Metres and Ratio preserve f32 units but impose no numerical policy, and Look already uses both for related hair controls.
observations.remaining: Owner fit is source-supported, not proof of identical validity bounds: signed offsets, zero softness/memory, positive radius/reach and bounded percentages may need different local admission policies. Follicles kink is documented in radians per root metre; it must not be equated to RadiansPerMetre without a dimensional proof.

observations.trace: Growth is an enum; its name method returns human-facing labels. GPU packing obtains an index from Growth::ALL with a zero fallback; current ALL order matches shader cases0–6.
observations.remaining: The current seven variants and cases are aligned in the inspected source. Manual future enum/list/shader drift is a policy/maintenance question, not a demonstrated current misencoding. Whorl handedness and the clockwise bool are retained without presuming every boolean needs an enum.
